com.oplus.athena.name: Athena Core Governor
com.oplus.athena.hardware_coupling: Hard-bound to Android system_server via JNI hooks and Binder IPC. Monitors CPU core affinity and low-memory killer (LMK).
com.oplus.athena.failure_mode: Immediate bootloop. Watchdog timer detects missing IPC service within 60s of boot; device crashes to Recovery or Qualcomm EDL crashdump.

com.oplus.safecenter.name: SafeCenter Permission Engine
com.oplus.safecenter.hardware_coupling: Renders runtime permission prompts, USB Debugging confirmation dialogues, and App Ops dialogs.
com.oplus.safecenter.failure_mode: Permanent USB lockout and permission crashes. Newly requested app permissions immediately crash. If USB debugging authorization is revoked, user is permanently locked out of ADB.

com.oplus.battery.name: SuperVOOC Power HAL
com.oplus.battery.hardware_coupling: Communicates with hardware Power Management IC (PMIC) and BQ25890 charge controller for 100W/80W charging.
com.oplus.battery.failure_mode: Charging throttling and thermal trip. Drops charging speed to baseline 5V/2A (10W), breaks battery percentage calculation, or trips false thermal shutoff warnings.

com.oplus.securityguard.name: SecurityGuard Keystore Bridge
com.oplus.securityguard.hardware_coupling: Bridges optical under-display fingerprint daemon, face unlock, and Android Keystore Hardware Abstraction Layer.
com.oplus.securityguard.failure_mode: Biometric and banking app failure. Fingerprint scanner reports 'Hardware unavailable'. Hardware-backed Keystore fails, causing banking and UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) to reject logins.

com.oplus.camera.name: OnePlus Camera & Hasselblad Bridge
com.oplus.camera.hardware_coupling: Proprietary multi-frame HDR engine, optical image stabilization (OIS) calibration, and ISP bridge.
com.oplus.camera.failure_mode: Complete camera subsystem crash. Stock camera fails to launch; third-party camera apps (WhatsApp, Instagram, GCam) freeze or show black viewfinders.

com.android.se.name: Secure Element Service
com.android.se.hardware_coupling: Implements OMAPI (Open Mobile API) routing for eSE (embedded Secure Element) and UICC SIM applets.
com.android.se.failure_mode: Contactless payment failure. Google Wallet contactless tap-and-pay and bank card tokenization stop functioning completely.

com.android.systemui.name: Android SystemUI
com.android.systemui.hardware_coupling: Host process for navigation gestures, status bar, notifications, and lock screen surface.
com.android.systemui.failure_mode: System black screen. User shell immediately terminates; system enters a repetitive restart loop.

com.oplus.ota.name: OxygenOS OTA Engine
com.oplus.ota.hardware_coupling: Downloads, verifies cryptographic signatures, and applies seamless A/B partition updates.
com.oplus.ota.failure_mode: OTA update brick. Device cannot query or install official OxygenOS security patches or OS upgrades.

com.oplus.romupdate.name: ROM Update Carrier Config Provider
com.oplus.romupdate.hardware_coupling: Pushes carrier-specific VoLTE/VoNR profiles, emergency dialing numbers, and modem baseband configurations.
com.oplus.romupdate.failure_mode: Cellular degradation / softbrick. Causes missing APNs, loss of 5G standalone carrier aggregation, and recurring crash popups on reboot.

com.oplus.cota.name: COTA Regional Carrier Service
com.oplus.cota.hardware_coupling: Delivers regional Indian carrier configurations (Jio, Airtel, Vi) for network slicing and 5G VoNR.
com.oplus.cota.failure_mode: Network slicing and VoLTE failure. May result in dropped calls or inability to latch onto Indian 5G SA bands.

com.google.android.gms.name: Google Play Services
com.google.android.gms.hardware_coupling: Provides Play Integrity API, Firebase Cloud Messaging (push notifications), Google OAuth, and location services.
com.google.android.gms.failure_mode: Total app ecosystem collapse. 95% of third-party apps fail to receive push notifications; all banking and financial apps fail integrity verification.

com.qualcomm.qti.telephonyservice.name: Qualcomm Telephony HAL
com.qualcomm.qti.telephonyservice.hardware_coupling: Interfaces Android TelephonyManager with Qualcomm Snapdragon baseband modem and RIL.
com.qualcomm.qti.telephonyservice.failure_mode: No cellular service / emergency call failure. SIM cards are not detected; emergency calling (112/911) is disabled.

com.android.phone.name: Core Telephony Framework
com.android.phone.hardware_coupling: Manages cellular radio state, call routing, and SIM subscription services.
com.android.phone.failure_mode: Dialer and call crashes. Phone app crashes on incoming/outgoing calls; VoLTE/VoNR drops.

com.android.settings.name: Android Settings Datastore
com.android.settings.hardware_coupling: Central user configuration UI and Settings Provider backend database.
com.android.settings.failure_mode: Settings crash / system lockout. All system settings become inaccessible; phone enters an unusable state.

com.oplus.aod.name: AOD & Optical Fingerprint Surface
com.oplus.aod.hardware_coupling: Draws the lockscreen ambient display and accurately renders the target illumination zone for optical fingerprint positioning.
com.oplus.aod.failure_mode: Broken in-display fingerprint. Optical sensor cannot illuminate finger without AOD positioning coordinates while the screen is off.

phase_1.name: Storage Cache Trim
phase_1.description: Executes UFS 4.0 storage TRIM via FITRIM ioctl to reclaim deleted flash blocks and purges temporary application cache up to 100GB.
phase_1.undo_note: One-way maintenance operation (garbage collection). App caches rebuild automatically during normal application execution.

phase_2.name: Window Animation Scales
phase_2.description: Halves window animation scale, transition animation scale, and animator duration scale to 0.5x for snappy, fluid UI interactions.

phase_3.name: Battery & Radio Optimizations
phase_3.description: Disables background Wi-Fi and Bluetooth Low Energy scanning when off, prevents cellular modem from staying awake while connected to Wi-Fi, and enables adaptive battery management.

phase_4.name: Doze Power-Saving Whitelist
phase_4.description: Whitelists critical communication, VoIP, and media applications from aggressive OxygenOS deep Doze sleep suppression to prevent delayed push notifications and audio drops.

phase_5.name: Safe Telemetry Freeze
phase_5.description: Safely disables non-essential OEM telemetry, analytics uploaders, HeyTap promotional services, and Facebook background daemons for user 0, gracefully skipping absent packages on OxygenOS 15/16 India.

phase_6.name: App & System AOT Speed Compilation
phase_6.description: Compiles 10 core performance-sensitive applications directly to native ARM64 machine code (-m speed) to eliminate JIT startup delay, and performs system-wide profile-guided optimization (-m speed-profile -a).

phase_7.name: Google Wallet & NFC Quick-Access Tile
phase_7.description: Enables NFC radio, assigns Google Play Services Host Card Emulation (HCE) component as default contactless payment service, and activates Quick Access Wallet on the lockscreen and Quick Settings.

phase_8.name: GPU Rendering & Qualcomm Game Driver
phase_8.description: Opts into Qualcomm Adreno dedicated Game Driver pipeline (GAME_DRIVER_ALL_APPS) for all apps, improving frame pacing and shader caching. Explicitly warns against harmful legacy hacks like Disable HW Overlays.
phase_8.safety_warning: NEVER enable 'Disable HW Overlays' (SurfaceFlinger 1008). Bypassing Qualcomm's dedicated Hardware Composer ASIC forces Adreno 740 to composite 2D layers, causing massive battery drain and thermal throttling.

phase_9.name: Process Scheduler & Phantom Limits
phase_9.description: Removes Android 12+ phantom process killer restrictions (raising limit to INT_MAX) to prevent Termux/background worker terminations, and expands cached processes to 64 to leverage 12GB/16GB LPDDR5X RAM.

phase_10.name: Private DNS DoT & Network Tuning
phase_10.description: Enforces system-wide DNS-over-TLS (DoT) via AdGuard (or Cloudflare) for native network-level telemetry and advertisement blocking, and activates Wi-Fi background scan throttling.

phase_11.name: Thermal & High Performance Mode
phase_11.description: Toggles OxygenOS native High Performance Mode to raise EAS CPU frequency floor levels and delay thermal throttling onset for intensive tasks and gaming.

phase_12.name: Display True 120Hz Refresh Rate
phase_12.description: Bypasses OxygenOS proprietary per-app downclocking table (oplus_customize_screen_refresh_rate 0) to force true 120Hz refresh rate across Chrome, YouTube, Maps, and all apps.
